    Graded covering categories and Lemma 4.7 #

    Definition 4.5 (def:graded-covering-category, scalar-normalization.tex): for an algebra graded by a group 𝒢, with chosen primitive idempotents of identity degree, the graded covering category has objects (x, g) and morphisms B(x, y)_{g⁻¹h} from (x, g) to (y, h).

    We work with a family F : ι → C in a k-linear category whose Hom spaces are 𝒢-graded compatibly with composition (HomGrading); the algebra is B = (Alg F)ᵒᵖ. A finite full subcategory of the graded covering category, with objects s p = (x_p, g_p), has the category algebra cov s: the subalgebra of (Alg (F ∘ x))ᵒᵖ of the matrices with (p, q)-entry in degree g_p⁻¹ g_q.

    Lemma 4.7 (lem:homogeneous-projection, lines 305–320): "Projection π : B' → H onto the indicated homogeneous components is an H-bimodule retraction. Indeed, for p ∈ H(i,j), q ∈ H(l,m) and b ∈ B'(j,l), cancellation of the degrees of p and q in the grading group gives π(pbq) = p π(b) q. Lemma 4.6 therefore applies with C = D = H." (isRepresentationFinite_cov).

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.CatAlg.HomGrading {k : Type u} [Field k] {𝒞 : Type v} [CategoryTheory.Category.{w, v} 𝒞] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive 𝒞] [CategoryTheory.Linear k 𝒞] {ι : Type} (F : ι → 𝒞) (G : Type) [Group G] [DecidableEq G] :
    Type w

    A grading of the Hom spaces of a family by a group, compatible with composition, with identities in degree one.

    • proj : G → (x y : ι) → (F x ⟶ F y) →ₗ[k] F x ⟶ F y
    • proj_proj (g h : G) (x y : ι) (f : F x ⟶ F y) : (self.proj g x y) ((self.proj h x y) f) = if h = g then (self.proj h x y) f else 0
    • sum (x y : ι) (f : F x ⟶ F y) : ∃ (s : Finset G), f = ∑ g ∈ s, (self.proj g x y) f
    • proj_comp (g a b : G) (x y z : ι) (f : F x ⟶ F y) (f' : F y ⟶ F z) : (self.proj g x z) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((self.proj a x y) f) ((self.proj b y z) f')) = if a * b = g then CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((self.proj a x y) f) ((self.proj b y z) f') else 0
    • proj_id (g : G) (x : ι) : (self.proj g x x) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (F x)) = if 1 = g then CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (F x) else 0
